TC-14/S23.title: Real iPhone and Android: microphone dictation, Generate, lock or background for 30 s; then a wrong device clock
TC-14/S23.detail: Not runnable here: it needs a real voice on a real phone and the live note model (forbidden on the local stack; on dev microphone dictation and phones are set aside). What the code says on 43c38a4f, recorded: the note is generated by the page (On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/).), so a phone that suspends or kills the web view before the model answers loses the note the way TC-14/S07 cells B/D and TC-25/S14 show; an Android emulator run on e02167f (dvc, OAT-03/S20) kept the note after 30 s in the background with a 25 s scripted model wait. The wrong-device-clock half is S27 (web) and known B18.
